details: Workspace administrators can select one project for a CSV export.
The default remains an export of every project they can access.
Webhook endpoints can opt into signature version 2.
Version 1 verification will stop being supported on the migration deadline.

migration.action: Enable signature version 2 in the webhook endpoint settings and update the receiver to verify the X-Harbor-Signature-V2 header.

changes.summary: Incident exports use stable severity codes
details: Incident CSV exports replace display labels with severity_code values.
Mappings based on translated display labels are affected.

migration.action: Update incident import mappings to read severity_code instead of the translated severity label.

details: A future updater may rewrite webhook receiver settings automatically.
The on-call telemetry dashboard is now named harbor-north.
